description: This file defines an abstract base class for Drupal's DateTime field formatter plugins, including methods for rendering date fields with timezone handling and formatting.

classes.name: DateTimeFormatterBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for date/time field formatter plugins in Drupal, providing common functionality for date rendering and timezone management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing formatter services and storage.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the formatter with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default formatter settings, including timezone override.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the settings form for the formatter, including timezone override options.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current formatter settings.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Generates renderable elements for each date item, including ISO attributes.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Abstract method to format a date object into a string.

methods.name: setTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the timezone on a DrupalDateTime object based on field settings.

methods.name: getFormatSettings
methods.description: Returns settings array for date formatting, including timezone override.

methods.name: buildDate
methods.description: Creates a render array for a date object.

methods.name: buildDateWithIsoAttribute
methods.description: Creates a render array for a date object with ISO datetime attribute.
